title: Written Answer to PQ on Trends in Job Vacancies
vacancy_change_context: The decline in vacancies was mainly in non-PMET roles.
ai_response_population: Firms that had adopted AI; about three in ten firms had adopted AI at the time of the cited survey.
rounding: Employment-response percentages are rounded values reported in the parliamentary answer.
limitations: The vacancy totals are national and cannot be assigned to detailed SSOC occupations.
The firm responses are reported among AI-adopting firms and do not identify AI's causal effect on employment.
Entry-level PMET openings use the source definition and are not a complete measure of outcomes for first-time jobseekers.
